items.subject: Greater London Authority is hiring a Public Liaison Officer x2
items.summary: Six vacancies were listed; the closest matches are two Public Liaison Officer posts at the Greater London Authority and a senior MIS, data and compliance role at John Ruskin College.
items.action: Review the GLA and John Ruskin College roles first, comparing salary, requirements, closing dates and commute before deciding whether to apply.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether either shortlisted role is worth applying for.
